Reading what fx printed

This lesson gets you to read an output of fx and say which input produced it. fx multiplies its input by six, so an output names the input that produced it. You will read the output before the explanation.

$ node -e "console.log(fx(7))"
42

fx multiplies its input by six, so an output read backwards is the input times six: divide by six to find the input.

The factor is six. [1]

The body of fx is return n * 6;. [2]

Called with 7, fx returns 42. [3]
